metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for agent memory and verification — second-brain domain-agent lifecycle, apiary multi-contributor knowledge bases, and scout-generator-critic-mediator adversarial review

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Create, adopt, audit, and improve domain agents with persistent knowledge files and five self-reinforcement loops. Agents bootstrap the single-sourced operating protocol via operate mode. Use for /second-brain operate|create|adopt|audit|improve|add-workflow|wrap.

plugins.name: apiary
plugins.description: Hive Parent Protocol — multi-contributor git-backed knowledge bases with Parliament triage and Sentinel scanning. Use for /apiary create|operate|audit|upgrade.

plugins.name: scout-generator-critic-mediator
plugins.description: Composable multi-agent verification — scout, generate, critique, mediate, with structured checklists and confidence scoring. Use for /sgcm (full loop) or /gcm|cm|m (narrower levels).
